content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-3. - Issuance of summons.
content.summary:
A summons and complaint may be issued by a peace officer in the manner set forth in
section 58-4
.
(Code 1960, § 1-19; Code 1981, § 18-6; Ord. No. 3483, § 2, 10-5-1998)
State Law reference—
Commencement of actions, C.R.S. § 13-10-111.
